{{Quote|On behalf of the Taris Reconstruction Authority, welcome home.|A Republic quartermaster greets a Cathar settler on Taris|<ref name="Ambient2">{{TORcite|type=location|Ambient dialogue in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Olaris]]|[[Taris/Legends|Taris]]}}</ref>}}
The '''Taris Reconstruction Authority''' was the organization that oversaw the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative|reconstruction]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
